scope: Full current Studio HTTP maintenance and reverse recovery tests
assessment: HTTP reverse recovery rejects forward endpoint, then resumes/rolls back using explicit source and preserves artifacts/runs
HTTP plan/prepare/commit/restore keeps active object valid and reports exact source files and phases
Wrong confirmation, blank actor, unknown/query workspace override or invalid retention rejects while retaining source bytes
Preparation resume preserves copy inode; cancellation blocks later commit; partial-copy resume refuses overwrite
Fixture-only purge requires expired retention and exact PURGE confirmation; active recovery copy retained
Interrupted fixture deletion reloads exact plan after server restart, rejects replacement plan and resumes remaining deletion
limitations: HTTP service only, not actual browser interaction
Disposable test purge does not grant real product deletion approval
Injected I/O failures and same-filesystem fixtures; real products and cross-volume acceptance remain open
